notes: 2026-07-20: The founder-provided 'catering_baking_resources.csv' contained only real data for its 10 books — all 10 channels and all 10 blogs were unresolved placeholders ('Business Channel 1'–'10', 'generic.com'), unlike every other CSV processed this project. Channels and blogs for this category were therefore independently sourced and verified from scratch rather than merged from the CSV. Real, rich Nigeria-specific business content exists in blog form (WithinNigeria's 'Complete Guide to Starting a Catering Business in Nigeria for Owambe Events') — confirmed and added this pass. Two channels (Sussy's Cakes Recipes, Diary of a Kitchen Lover) are primarily recipe/technique content with a real but secondary business thread, flagged individually rather than presented as pure business channels.
actionRequired: 2026-08-04: Removed generic personal-dev books (Atomic Habits etc.) and pure-news blogs (BusinessDay, Nairametrics, Connect Nigeria, BellaNaija). Replaced with free practical business books (E-Myth, Profit First, Markup & Profit, How Much Should I Charge?, Lean Startup, Rework, Personal MBA, Traction, Company of One, OpenStax Entrepreneurship) and Nigerian/African SME blogs. Priority: Nigeria → Africa → Global. All books free.
